_purpose: Scores all 5 gates, computes composite, issues terminal status. Every gate score must reference evidence_ids. Silent promotion is forbidden (Section 9.12).
milestones_for_buyer_ready: <specific milestone required to reach LEVEL_4_BUYER_READY; each must reference the evidence_id gap it would close>
_adjudication_rules: If PATENT_GATE < 70 OR EVIDENCE_GATE < 70 → WOULD_NOT_PAY (regardless of composite).
If all gates pass AND composite ≥ 70 AND milestones list is non-empty → WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES.
If all gates pass AND composite ≥ 70 AND milestones list is empty → LEVEL_4_BUYER_READY.
A WOULD_CONSIDER_WITH_MILESTONES verdict with an empty milestones list is a CI failure (Section 9.9).
A LEVEL_4_BUYER_READY verdict with any non-empty milestones list is a CI failure (Section 9.9).
Every gate score must have a non-empty evidence_pointer. A gate with no evidence_pointer is a silent promotion (Section 9.9).
buyer_test_question: If you were <buyer>'s CTO/CSO/BD lead, would you pay to acquire or license this invention today?
